title: Uniform low-degree resolvent-moment bound
objective: Express the canonical level-two correction C_{2,beta} through bounded precedence moments and prove or refute a uniform Loewner bound strong enough for C001.
acceptance_checks: Keeps all noncommutative multiplication orders explicit.
Distinguishes the stronger one-epoch A-energy target from C001 itself.
Provides either a quantified proof draft or a reproducible finite obstruction.
Does not promote the float64 C011 specialization to a general theorem.
